key_insight: The FrontierOR Challenge tests whether LLM-agent workflows can design scalable optimization algorithms across diverse operations research problems.
engineering_relevance: Automated algorithm design could reduce specialist effort for routing, scheduling, and network design, but reliable performance at realistic scale remains unproven.
method: Build agentic workflows that design, test, and improve optimization algorithms.
Stage 1 releases 60 audited problems; Stage 2 adds new problems with unseen instances.
Evaluate separately in a network-isolated Main track and a timed Self-hosted track.
evidence_signal: In the benchmark’s one-shot evaluation, the strongest model achieved an objective within 1% of Gurobi’s with no slower runtime on only 39% of large instances; challenge scoring checks feasibility and averages objective-to-reference ratios over hidden instances.
watch_item: The abstract reports a baseline and challenge protocol, not demonstrated gains from submitted agentic workflows.
paper_title: The FrontierOR Challenge: Agentic Algorithm Design for Operations Research
